WITH web_v1 AS (
    SELECT 
        ws_item_sk AS item_sk,
        d_date,
        SUM(ws_sales_price) OVER (PARTITION BY ws_item_sk ORDER BY d_date) AS cume_sales
    FROM web_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1212 AND 1212+11
),
 store_v1 AS (
    SELECT 
        ss_item_sk AS item_sk,
        d_date,
        SUM(ss_sales_price) OVER (PARTITION BY ss_item_sk ORDER BY d_date) AS cume_sales
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1212 AND 1212+11
)
SELECT 
    item_sk,
    d_date,
    COALESCE(web_sales, 0) AS web_sales,
    COALESCE(store_sales, 0) AS store_sales,
    MAX(COALESCE(web_sales, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY item_sk ORDER BY d_date) AS web_cumulative,
    MAX(COALESCE(store_sales, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY item_sk ORDER BY d_date) AS store_cumulative
FROM (
    SELECT 
        item_sk,
        d_date,
        web_sales,
        store_sales
    FROM (
        SELECT item_sk, d_date, cume_sales AS web_sales
        FROM web_v1
        UNION ALL
        SELECT item_sk, d_date, cume_sales AS store_sales
        FROM store_v1
    ) t
    FULL OUTER JOIN (
        SELECT item_sk, d_date
        FROM (
            SELECT item_sk, d_date
            FROM web_v1
            UNION ALL
            SELECT item_sk, d_date
            FROM store_v1
        ) u
    ) v ON t.item_sk = v.item_sk AND t.d_date = v.d_date
) x
WHERE web_cumulative > store_cumulative
ORDER BY item_sk, d_date
LIMIT 100
